summary: Copy-to-clipboard button whose icon turns into a drawn check as the label rolls to "Copied"; it says so when the browser refuses.

props.name: text
props.description: Text written to the clipboard. Read on each click.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label shown for 1.8 s after a successful copy.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after each copy attempt; `ok` is false when the clipboard write was rejected.

accessibility: A native `<button>`; its accessible name is the visible label.
The label is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so "Copied" or "Couldn’t copy" is announced.
The clipboard and check icons are `aria-hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion the label swaps without rolling and the check pop and pixel sparks are skipped; the icon cross-fade still runs.
notes: Uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, which requires a secure context (HTTPS or localhost). On failure the label reads "Couldn’t copy", built in English.
The button carries `data-state="done"` or `data-state="fail"` for 1.8 s after a click, `data-state="idle"` otherwise.
The button keeps the width of its longest label, so it does not change size as the label rolls.
`onCopy` replaces the native clipboard `copy` event handler of the same name.
